name: DecideInsuranceRequest
description: A person approves one credit-insurance increase proposal on the insurance screen: a CreditLimitRequests row in הוצעה ע״י הסוכנת moves to אושר – לא הוגש, with decidedBy and decidedAt. Nothing is submitted to the insurer (the API connection opens when keys arrive). Refuses any other current status, so a request is never approved twice.

decidedBy.description: Display name of the person approving

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Approving an increase proposal**: "אישור" on the increase proposal shown in the customer card's "אובליגו וביטוח" tab, while its status is "הוצעה"
  Marks the proposal "אושר – לא הוגש" and records who approved it and when. Nothing is submitted to the insurer; submission opens once the insurer's API keys arrive. If the proposal was already decided, the screen shows why the approval was refused.
